scientific_integrity: Main result is a full-range proof of a specifically cited public conjecture. Earlier parameter-one and order-three cases are credited. No independent mathematical review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classical Sierpiński graphs only; no enumeration of all minimum sets or generalized base graphs. Finite computations supplement an unbounded symbolic proof. Historical priority beyond inspected public material and independent validation remain unverified.
title: Exact \(k\)-limited domination of every classical Sierpiński graph
